themes.name: Server attitude and attentiveness
themes.description: Waitstaff and bartender friendliness, rudeness, attentiveness, knowledge of the menu, and responsiveness during the meal, such as drink refills, being checked on, or being ignored.

themes.name: Hostess and seating policy
themes.description: Experiences at the host stand, including rude or welcoming hostesses, refusal to seat partial parties or solo diners, empty tables held back, and how guests are seated or turned away.

themes.name: Reservations and wait times
themes.description: How easy it is to get a reservation, lost or mishandled reservations, delays seating guests with reservations, walk-in waits, and advice to book ahead.

themes.name: Speed and pacing of service
themes.description: How quickly drinks, food and the check arrive, long gaps between courses, dishes arriving all at once, or feeling rushed through the meal.

themes.name: Saltiness and seasoning
themes.description: Whether dishes were over-salted, bland, under-seasoned, over-spiced, or well-balanced in flavor.

themes.name: Prices and portion sizes
themes.description: Value for money, cost of dishes and drinks, and whether portions or small plates were large enough for the price.

themes.name: Wood-fired oysters
themes.description: The wood-fired or char-grilled oysters with chili garlic butter, including their flavor, sauce, size, and how they compare to oysters elsewhere.

themes.name: Fried alligator
themes.description: The fried alligator appetizer, including its texture (chewy or tender), the chili garlic mayo sauce, and whether it was worth trying.

themes.name: Louisiana cochon
themes.description: The signature Louisiana cochon entree of pulled pork with cabbage, cracklins and pickled turnips or peaches, including its flavor, temperature, dryness and saltiness.

themes.name: Rabbit and dumplings
themes.description: The rabbit and dumplings entree, including its flavor, the amount of rabbit, the dumplings, and comparisons to pot pie or stew.

themes.name: Mac and cheese
themes.description: The macaroni and cheese casserole side, whether praised as a standout or criticized as bland or overcooked.

themes.name: Pork ribs
themes.description: The smoked pork ribs with watermelon pickle, including tenderness, dryness, sauce, and smoke flavor.

themes.name: Pork cheeks
themes.description: The braised pork cheeks appetizer, including tenderness, flavor, portion size, and whether it was a standout.

themes.name: Gumbo
themes.description: The gumbo varieties, such as deviled egg, chicken and andouille, duck, or black-eyed pea, including roux, saltiness, portion size, and price.

themes.name: Brisket
themes.description: The smoked beef brisket and horseradish potato salad, including tenderness, fattiness, flavor, and comparisons to other brisket.

themes.name: Ham hock
themes.description: The smoked ham hock entree, including tenderness, dryness, saltiness, smoke flavor and accompaniments.

themes.name: Boudin and charcuterie
themes.description: The fried boudin balls, boucherie plate, head cheese and other house-cured meats, including their quality and flavor.

themes.name: Fish entrees
themes.description: Fish dishes such as catfish courtbouillon, redfish, drum, gulf fish and other daily fish specials, including flavor, doneness and freshness.

themes.name: Bread and rolls
themes.description: The complimentary bread and rolls with butter, including quality, whether they were offered or refilled, and complaints about getting them.

themes.name: Desserts
themes.description: Dessert choices such as pineapple upside-down cake, chocolate cake, pies and puddings, including taste and quality.

themes.name: Cocktails and drinks
themes.description: The cocktail menu, bourbon and whiskey selection, beer, wine list and non-alcoholic drinks, including quality, size and bar service.

themes.name: Ambiance and noise level
themes.description: Decor, lighting, seating comfort and spacing, temperature, and how loud the restaurant is, including its hipster or rustic feel.

themes.name: Splitting checks and special requests
themes.description: The policy against splitting checks, refusals to substitute menu items or accommodate dietary needs, and takeout or to-go limitations.

themes.name: Vegetarian and dietary options
themes.description: How well the menu suits vegetarians, vegans, pescatarians, and guests with allergies such as peanuts, given the pork-focused menu.

themes.name: Oyster and bacon sandwich
themes.description: The fried oyster and bacon sandwich, including its flavor, size, and bread.

themes.name: Cochon versus Cochon Butcher
themes.description: Confusion between Cochon and the neighboring Cochon Butcher, and comparisons favoring one over the other.

themes.name: Food safety and cleanliness
themes.description: Reports of illness after eating, cockroaches, dirty restrooms, hair or foreign objects in food, and general cleanliness.

themes.name: Hype and expectations
themes.description: Whether the restaurant lived up to its reviews, awards, media coverage and reputation, including tourist-trap and overrated comments.
